jobs.prompt: Generate an image. [Purpose] Artwork for a macOS app icon of a screen and meeting recorder app; it will be masked into a rounded square later. [Core brief] A minimal, premium object illustration: a small sleek dark graphite display panel seen straight-on, with a glowing coral-red record dot in its center, and below the dot three short horizontal light lines like transcript text. [Style] Modern macOS Big Sur / Sonoma icon style: soft 3D, subtle gradients, gentle top-left lighting, smooth glossy materials, clean and friendly, not skeuomorphic clutter. [Composition] Full-bleed square artwork filling the whole canvas with a warm off-white to light grey gradient background; the display object centered and occupying about 60 percent of the width; generous even margin; no rounded corners, no border, no frame around the canvas. [Color] graphite #1c1c1a, coral red #e5484d, warm off-white. [Text rules] no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark. [Constraints] single object, flat background, no shadow cut off at edges.
